A fire outbreak has ravaged the Gwagwalada Main Market in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja. An eyewitness who recorded the incident in a video shared on Facebook claimed that the fire started at about 7pm on Saturday and was still burning when he posted the footage. The video was shared by Sani Usman Zakariyya, who called on the relevant authorities and emergency responders to intervene urgently. In the accompanying caption, he wrote, “FIRE OUTBREAK IN GWAGWALADA MAIN MARKET. The attention of fire service is urgently needed, and the security are afraid to open the market for security reasons. “The authorities should act fast before it spreads further. It’s not getting better at all. I’m currently at the scene in the market.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience.
